eligible.text: Based on the information provided, you may meet the core requirements for Spain's Digital Nomad Visa.

needs_review.text: Eligibility cannot be confirmed automatically. Your information requires manual review, and our team should follow up by email.

not_eligible.text: Based on the information provided, you do not currently appear to meet the core income requirement for Spain's Digital Nomad Visa.

employee_employer_located_in_spain.text: Spain's Digital Nomad Visa requires employees to work for a company located outside Spain. Based on the information provided, this pathway does not appear to match your employment situation.

employee_foreign_employment_duration_bel.text: Based on the information provided, your employment relationship with the foreign employer does not yet meet the 3-month minimum required for Spain's Digital Nomad Visa.

employee_remote_work_not_approved.text: Spain's Digital Nomad Visa requires that your role can be performed remotely with your employer's approval. Based on the information provided, this pathway does not currently appear to match your situation.

contractor_foreign_client_relationship_m.text: Spain's Digital Nomad Visa requires self-employed applicants to have a professional relationship with at least one client or company located outside Spain. Based on the information provided, this pathway does not appear to match your situation.

contractor_foreign_client_duration_below.text: Based on the information provided, your professional relationship with the foreign client or company does not yet meet the 3-month minimum required for Spain's Digital Nomad Visa.

contractor_spanish_activity_above_thresh.text: Spain limits self-employed applicants to 20% of total professional activity for Spain-based clients or companies. Based on the percentage provided, this pathway does not currently appear to match your situation.

supporting_company_operating_history_bel.text: Spain's Digital Nomad Visa requires the company you're relying on for this application to have been operating for at least 1 year. Based on the information provided, this pathway does not currently appear to match your situation.
